mil3.1.10:1.3: Sampasādanalakkhaṇā ca mahārāja saddhā sampakkhandanalakkhaṇā cāti.-
mil3.1.10:1.5: Saddhā kho mahārāja uppajjamānā nīvaraṇe vikkhambheti, vinīvaraṇaṃ cittaṃ hoti acchaṃ vippasannaṃ anāvilaṃ,
mil3.1.10:1.6: evaṃ kho mahārāja sampasādanalakkhaṇā saddhā ti.-
mil3.1.10:2.2: Yathā mahārāja rājā cakkavattī caturanginiyā senāya saddhiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno parittaṃ udakaṃ tareyya, taṃ udakaṃ hatthīhi ca assehi ca rathehi ca pattīhi ca khubhitaṃ bhaveyya āvilaṃ luḷitaṃ kalalībhūtaṃ,
mil3.1.10:2.3: uttiṇṇo ca rājā cakkavattī manusse āṇāpeyya: pānīyaṃ bhaṇe āharatha, pivissāmīti, rañño udakappasādako maṇi bhaveyya,
mil3.1.10:2.4: evaṃ devāti kho te manussā rañño cakkavattissa paṭissutvā taṃ udakappasādakaṃ maṇiṃ udake pakkhipeyyuṃ, tasmiṃ udake pakkhittamatte sankha-sevālapaṇakaṃ vigaccheyya kaddamo ca sannisīdeyya, acchambhaveyya udakaṃ vippasannaṃ anāvilaṃ,
mil3.1.10:2.5: tato rañño cakkavattissa pānīyaṃ upanāmeyyuṃ: pivatu devo pānīyan-ti.
mil3.1.10:3.1: Yathā mahārāja udakaṃ evaṃ cittaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ, yathā te manussā evaṃ yogāvacaro daṭṭhabbo, yathā sankha-sevāla-paṇakaṃ kaddamo ca evaṃ kilesā daṭṭhabbā,
mil3.1.10:3.2: yathā udakappasādako maṇi evaṃ saddhā daṭṭhabbā, yathā udakappasādake maṇimhi udake pakkhittamatte sankha-sevāla-paṇakaṃ vigaccheyya kaddamo ca sannisīdeyya, accham-bhaveyya udakaṃ vippasannaṃ anāvilaṃ,
mil3.1.10:3.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja saddhā uppajjamānā nīvaraṇe vikkhambheti, vinīvaraṇaṃ cittaṃ hoti acchaṃ vippasannaṃ anāvilaṃ.
